summary: Configured node2 to securely pull `/etc/inventory/app.conf` from node1 every 15 minutes. Verified an actual source change synchronized with identical SHA-256 content, and confirmed persistence after sequential restarts of both nodes.
actions_performed: Created the initially missing authoritative file on node1.
Created a node-generated ED25519 key and least-privilege `inventorysync` reader account.
Installed an atomic SCP-based synchronization job under Alpine's `/etc/periodic/15min`.
Verified a real node1 content change propagated to node2.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities, services, data, and live synchronization recovery.

evidence.requirement: Synchronize node2 from node1 within 15 minutes
evidence.summary: Shows the `*/15` scheduler, a changed node1 hash, node2's prior hash, and successful pickup with matching hash and content.

evidence.requirement: Secure source access and end-to-end synchronization health
evidence.summary: Proves node2 can read node1 using its dedicated key and that source/target hashes remain identical.

Healthy baseline boot ID `35357529-a0fa-4786-9c4e-61d35ea15352`, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID `2a00971b-9610-448b-a8f6-1573c6f88611`, recovered SSH/source data, and successful downstream synchronization.

Healthy baseline boot ID `5716e7fd-e5d9-4334-a9c0-a2ba47dad387`, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID `fc02ea7a-7196-4138-8920-3faa0a71553d`, recovered `crond`, persisted target data and schedule, and live post-restart source/target parity.
